# T16 — Project registers at closure (2026-11-23)

The project-scoped registers at the close gate, plus the programme rows that bind this project.

## Risks

No open project-scoped risk row at closure. The programme risk register holds the live risks; the
tranche-4 review reads them, not this project page.

## Issues

No open project-scoped issue row at closure.

## Assumptions

- The record is retrospective and dated 2026-11-23; no row is backdated.
- Delivery contract v2 is the live contract; v1 is superseded and retained for history.
- The capability is bound by the adopted profile `conveyor-software-delivery`.

## Dependencies

- T16 follows T2 (architecture contracts) and T13 (broker/MinIO) per SPEC_V2 §12; both are live
  projects in tranche 3 with their own records.
- Bound execution depends on the process engine's PDDL step runner.

## Benefits

- B7 — tokens per demo-credited deliverable: baseline 630,565, target 504,452.
- B5 — one model store: the knowledge pack is bound by `knowledge_pack_ref`, not copied.

## Changes

- `Accept the T16 deliverables with their evidence` — approved. The six deliverables are complete
  against the frozen scope baseline; the change authorises recording their acceptance.
